False: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is disabled True: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is enabled Template Description Defines if this EcuInstance shall implement the dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping functionality on this Communication Connector and its respective PhysicalChannel. M2 Parameter CommunicationConnector.dynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled Mapping Rule Mapping Type If at least one dynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled attribute is defined and if at least one CommunicationConnector of the EcuInstance has dynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled set to true, then FrNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingSupport shall be set to true.
